suggestions.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Multi-Threading Fails You
suggestions.rationale: Developers constantly hit performance bottlenecks in Python multithreading and wonder why CPU utilization stays at 100% on a single core. This demystifies the CPython Global Interpreter Lock with high watch-time retention.
suggestions.hook_angle: Your Python multi-threading code is secretly running on a single core, and here is the exact reason why.

suggestions.topic: Docker Multi-Stage Builds: Slash Image Sizes
suggestions.rationale: Production deployments fail security scans and take too long to pull due to bloated multi-gigabyte container images. Multi-stage builds are an essential DevOps skill.
suggestions.hook_angle: Stop shipping 1-gigabyte Docker images to production when you only need a 20-megabyte binary.

suggestions.topic: LSM Tree vs B-Tree: How Databases Store Data
suggestions.rationale: System design interview candidates frequently trip up on storage engine internals. Comparing Log-Structured Merge-trees and B-Trees clarifies write-heavy vs read-heavy trade-offs.
suggestions.hook_angle: PostgreSQL uses B-Trees, but Cassandra uses LSM Trees—choosing the wrong one will destroy your write throughput.

suggestions.topic: Bloom Filters in Redis: Stop Cache Penetration
suggestions.rationale: High-traffic backend systems suffer from cache stampedes and malicious queries for non-existent keys. Bloom filters solve this memory-efficiently.
suggestions.hook_angle: How do top systems check if a billion records exist in milliseconds without querying the primary database?
